blurb: Join our 2-Hour Downtown Detroit City Walking Tour and discover the history, architecture, and cultural character of Michigan’s largest city. Explore approximately two miles through the heart of downtown, where historic landmarks, stunning Art Deco architecture, and public art tell the story of Detroit’s past and present. With insights from a knowledgeable local guide, you’ll uncover fascinating stories behind iconic buildings, civic spaces, and monuments. Admire grand facades, handcrafted details, and remarkable interiors while learning how Detroit’s industrial legacy shaped its vibrant modern identity. Perfect for history lovers, architecture enthusiasts, and first-time visitors, this walking tour offers an engaging and memorable introduction to downtown Detroit.
